routes.notes: renders the facts page; requires a logged-in GitLab session
form: page — URL of a file on the user's auto-created GitLab project; server fetches the file content via the GitLab API and shows it as a 'shark fact'

observations: On first login, the server creates a GitLab project for the user with a main branch.
The form posts a page URL; the server requires the URL to start with the user's project blob/main/ prefix.
If the fetched content (case-insensitively) equals 'blahaj is life', the server appends the flag to the response.
